markers.reading: Seeker works at the nearby grave from roughly 20–25 feet away, exposing its occupant.

evidence.quote: Seeker: So I stand back a good 20–25 feet from the area, briefly lower my goggles to my face, making a gentle scooping gesture as I lift the soft earth from the top layers of the grave.
expose the, um, the grave

markers.note: Presence denotes the grave investigation area; Seeker does not step into the grave.

I don't know what to do with any of that, but...
